## Summary

What this PR changes and why. Link the issue it closes (`Closes #NN`).

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `bun run test` passes
- [ ] `bun run typecheck` and `bun run build` pass
- [ ] A changeset is added if the change is user-facing (`bunx changeset`)
- [ ] Everything is in English (code, comments, docs, commit messages)
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or public API changed (`docs/`, `apps/docs/`, package READMEs)
